backward-induction-transcendence.summary: Necessity via backward induction on Mulan's winning strategy tree + transcendence-degree field tower; re-derives the four primitive families mechanically from the cut formula's affine structure (avoiding the hand-list-omission bug) but its core WLOG-x1-in-K_i lemma is only a proof sketch and its closure step imports corrected-genericity-bound's still-unproven C*(theta) closed form.

binary-word-invariant.last_note: Found the shift move; reviewer independently hand/computer-verified the full 8-move θ=180/7 witness and the general n≥2 construction move-by-move — genuine, not a search artifact. Necessity S⊆{180/n} still an honestly-stated open gap.
binary-word-invariant.summary: Reformulates the game as a monoid orbit of θ/180 under {x/2, 180-x}, abstracting away the spectator angle; orbit reproduces dyadic-scaffold's family exactly (sanity-checked), and the discriminating test is whether 180/7 needs a third generator; hardest step (orbit-non-membership ⟹ unforceable) flagged as high-risk.

corrected-genericity-bound.last_note: Claimed solved (S=F, 180/7 not forceable) but refuted: closure C(V) in §3 omits the shift operation a↦a-θ, so the necessity theorem is false — reviewer reproduced the 180/7 witness exactly, contradicting this approach's headline claim. Sub-lemmas (double-hit dichotomy, junk propagation) certified separately.
corrected-genericity-bound.summary: Necessity-side audit: proves the prior double-hit-only genericity argument (S={90/2^k}) is refuted by the transfer lemma's single-hit forced transitions; attempts a repaired genericity bound or a denominator/2-adic invariant to bound S above beyond θ>90, importing dyadic-scaffold's construction to complete the claim if successful.

denominator-valuation-necessity.last_note: Cleanliness Lemma independently re-derived and computer-verified (targeted exact-Fraction search, 0/17500 counterexamples for non-integer T vs tens of thousands when T forced integer); necessity theorem's induction and case coverage airtight; combined with certified sufficiency lemma gives full solve S={180/n : n>=2}.
denominator-valuation-necessity.summary: Necessity via elementary 2-adic/denominator bookkeeping on a concrete rational Shan-Yu start, no transcendence machinery; irrational-theta sub-case nearly closes (modulo a small residual wild-x1 gap), rational-theta sub-case rests entirely on an unproved odd-part-of-denominator invariant flagged as open conjecture.

dyadic-scaffold.last_note: Correct, gap-free floor (θ>90 impossible; dyadic family {180/((2^k+1)2^j)}⊆S), verified by reviewer; superseded (not wrong) by binary-word-invariant's larger family; exact upper bound on S still open.
dyadic-scaffold.summary: Direct cevian-cut algebra (identity ★): proves θ>90 impossible (non-obtuse invariant) and θ=180/((2^k+1)2^j) forceable for all k,j≥0 via bisection+transfer lemmas; safe verified partial baseline, exact upper characterization open.

full-interval-hypothesis.last_note: Its restricted "pure-quantity" move monoid (bisection + cross-transfer) omits the shift move; the mod-7 obstruction it proves only holds inside that restricted family. Its headline suspicion ("180/7 witness is a search artifact") is refuted by binary-word-invariant's verified construction. Self-reported unsolved was appropriately hedged.
full-interval-hypothesis.summary: Attempts to prove S=(0,90] exactly via a nested/adaptive extension of the transfer-lemma recursion beyond the fixed {r,θ-r,180-θ} escape cycle; gated on hand-verifying the computational 180/7 witness first; must separately address irrational θ.
